title: PostgreSQL WAL, checkpoints and durability
brief: Relate PostgreSQL WAL and checkpoint controls to a tested durability promise.
outcomes: Interpret WAL progress and commit settings
Explain an isolated crash drill without extrapolating to lost storage
entry: General crash recovery and PostgreSQL architecture.

heading.title: WAL before data
heading.brief: Follow one purchase through WAL buffers, write, flush and heap pages; separate transaction visibility from durability and checkpoint progress.

heading.title: Checkpoints and pressure
heading.brief: Explain full-page images, checkpoint pacing and retained WAL with actual settings; separate restart needs from archive and slot retention.

heading.title: Acknowledgement settings
heading.brief: Compare synchronous_commit, fsync and storage flush assumptions; state exactly which failure can lose an acknowledged purchase.

heading.title: Crash and restart
heading.brief: Pin PostgreSQL version and settings, crash only an owned disposable server and verify purchase state; distinguish observations from the conceptual ordering model.
